summary: Backend-only testing of Wolf's Mind ASD gestionale. Created pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, 30 tests) against the public preview URL covering auth (cookies/JWT/bearer/logout), users+roles, tesserati CRUD, tipi-pacchetto (seed + CRUD), abbonamenti/lezioni residue, ricevute (shared numbering across admin+tecnico, auto-movimento, PDF, PATCH correction syncing movimento, DELETE->annullata, per-role visibility), Resend email with PDF attachment (delivered@resend.dev), WhatsApp link, movimenti CRUD + tecnico filtering, compensi math, dashboard, bilancio JSON+PDF, organizzazione GET/PATCH. Result: 28/30 passed. All functional business flows PASS. The 2 failures are auth-hardening gaps from the playbook (no brute-force lockout, CORS wildcard with credentials).

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 6+ consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401, no 429/423 lockout and no attempt counter. Playbook requires lockout after 5 failed attempts.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True -> Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*' with Allow-Credentials: true. Browsers reject credentialed (cookie) cross-origin requests in this config. Needs explicit origin list (e.g. the preview URL) or origin echo.

Receipt number counter is incremented BEFORE tesserato existence check, so a failed (404) create permanently burns a receipt number, leaving gaps in the fiscal numbering. Move _next_receipt_number after validation.
No existence check: deleting/patching a non-existent (but valid ObjectId) resource returns 200 {ok:true} instead of 404.
Documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md but NOT implemented in server.py. Either implement or remove from the credentials doc.
Any tecnico can create/edit any tesserato (no ownership scoping). Only DELETE is admin-restricted - confirm this is intended.

action_items: Add login brute-force lockout (track failed attempts per email/IP, return 429/423 after 5 fails with cooldown)
Replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with explicit origins since allow_credentials=True (cookie auth)
Generate ricevuta numero only after tesserato validation to avoid numbering gaps
Return 404 on delete/patch of non-existent documents (matched_count/deleted_count checks)
Implement or remove POST /api/auth/register (documented but missing)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 735 lines - consider splitting routers (auth/users, tesserati/abbonamenti, ricevute, contabilita/report) into modules.
@app.on_event('startup')/'shutdown' are deprecated in current FastAPI - migrate to lifespan context manager.
seed_admin logic is idempotent and correctly re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (verified: stored hash starts with $2b$). Good.
serialize() correctly strips _id and password_hash - verified no _id or password_hash leaks in any tested response.
Date filtering relies on lexicographic comparison of ISO strings; mixing 'YYYY-MM-DD' (ricevuta.data) with full ISO timestamps works but is fragile - consider storing normalized ISO datetimes.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral, all prefixed TEST_ and deleted in fixture teardown: tecnico user TEST_tec_<hex>@example.com (50%), tesserato TEST_Rossi Mario, temporary abbonamenti/lezioni/ricevute/movimenti/tipo pacchetto. Organizzazione doc was PATCHed back to its seeded values plus a 1px logo_base64 placeholder (main agent may want to clear logo_base64).
test_credentials: admin@wolfsmind.it / Admin2026! (works). Tecnico users are created on the fly by the test suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; do not edit). Only TestAuth::test_brute_force_lockout and TestCors::test_cors_credentials_explicit_origin fail - both are hardening gaps, not functional bugs. Ricevuta numbering assertions are relative (n, n+1, n+2) so they are re-runnable. Email test hits the real Resend integration with delivered@resend.dev and returned a valid email_id. Frontend has NOT been tested at all yet.
rca_of_the_issue: Lockout: server.py login() has no failed-attempt tracking collection/limit. CORS: backend/.env sets CORS_ORIGINS='*' and server.py passes it straight into CORSMiddleware alongside allow_credentials=True, which Starlette forwards as literal '*'; the browser CORS spec forbids wildcard + credentials. Currently masked because the frontend is served from the same origin as the API through the ingress.
